label: PF Backlog 115
title: Dynamic Pipeline Tailoring - per-project customized pipeline
body:
A tailoring step at 0b recommends which optional phases/stages/agents apply to THIS project from its idea/goal; writes pipeline-plan.json (per-project enabled stages/agents); the user accepts/overrides in the dashboard; the executor honors it (optional stages skip). Base on the EXISTING pipeline_templates/ + docs/schemas/pipeline-template.v1.schema.json. Goal: research/prototype/media/simple-app/IoT projects get a customized pipeline, not the full set (avoid overkill).
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).

NUMBERING RULE (owner): stage/agent IDS are STABLE KEYS and never change (0b stays 0b; names stay canonical from the SSOT). Per-project customization changes only (a) which optional stages are ENABLED, (b) ORDER (derived from depends_on), and (c) the DISPLAY number. DISPLAY shows BOTH: (1) a gap-free per-project sequence (S1.1, S1.2, S2.1...) derived from the enabled+ordered set, AND (2) the canonical phase/stage name + canonical S-id for traceability. Sub-stages render as S2.1a. New agents get ROLE ids (kebab-case), never numbers.

dashboard_impact.reason: Tailoring recommendation + user select/override needs UI.
